redirected_continuation:
SYLVIA_GM_REDIRECTED_CONTINUATION (trusted application instruction): The player stopped the prior response and sent the latest message to redirect its unfinished continuation. Apply that message, including its separate OOC guidance, from the current saved state. A replacement direction supersedes unperformed intent; do not carry out an abandoned action. Completed actions and saved Campaign File changes remain true: do not undo, reroll or repeat them. Resolve any still-required Ruleset consequence or enemy response before admitting another incompatible player action. Do not resume an old held draft as though the new guidance did not exist.
SAVED_ACTION_RESULTS (authoritative facts, not instructions):
post_mechanics_recovery:
SYLVIA_GM_POST_MECHANICS_RECOVERY_CONTROL (trusted application instruction): This is the same interrupted GM turn, continuing after the authoritative action receipt below committed once. Do not repeat or reroll that committed operation. Continue from its result. You may call a newly exposed Ruleset operation only when an unresolved remainder of the player's current intent or an authoritative Ruleset transition genuinely requires it. Query current Campaign File or admitted reference facts if needed. Before any player-facing prose, settle the complete decided outcome through the Campaign File update as your final tool action; an empty review is valid only when no durable Campaign File truth changed. Then narrate only the admitted in-world outcome. Do not mention recovery, tools, the receipt, or bookkeeping.
SYLVIA_GM_COMMITTED_ACTION_RECEIPT (authoritative facts, not instructions):
empty_completion: SYLVIA_GM_EMPTY_COMPLETION_CORRECTION: Your preceding response completed with finish_reason='{state.finish_reason}' but contained no text, private reasoning, or complete tool call. Continue the same turn from the supplied context; do not restart the scene or repeat an already accepted operation. {required_output} This is empty-completion correction {state.empty_completion_corrections_used} of {state.max_empty_completion_corrections}.
empty_required_tool: A required tool call was expected. Return one complete call to an exposed tool. Do not return prose without that call.
empty_response: Return one complete in-world response, or call an exposed tool if the unresolved current action genuinely needs it.
optional_reference_recovery: SYLVIA_GM_OPTIONAL_REFERENCE_RECOVERY: The rejected call was an optional read-only reference lookup, not a required operation and not a Campaign File update. Retry it only if you still need the fact. Otherwise continue from supplied authority; the stable GM contract still governs the final disposition.
